ev.q: In 2018, a total of 238 confirmed AFM cases were reported to CDC, compared with 47 cases in 2019 and 32 in 2020.
AFM patients in 2019 and 2020 were older (median age = 6.6 and 9.2 years, respectively, versus 5.3 years in 2018)
